title: SwitchingAction
description: Command request sent to a grid-control service when TAF10 telemetry indicates a load peak, a feed-in peak, or a voltage-band violation.

gridNodeId.description: Grid node where the protective action is requested.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp of the measurement that triggered the action.

measuredActivePowerPlusW.description: Measured grid import in W at trigger time.

measuredActivePowerMinusW.description: Measured grid feed-in in W at trigger time.

measuredVoltageV.description: Measured voltage in V at trigger time.

targetAssetId.description: Optional controllable asset selected by downstream grid-control logic.
